interface.title: Harmonic descriptors app (Harmonic Descriptors Implementation)
interface.field: Musicology / music information retrieval (spectral analysis of harmony in audio recordings)
interface.stage_of_work: Analysis and visualisation of recorded musical excerpts after hand-segmenting them into chords
interface.what_it_is_for: Computes CQT-based static and dynamic harmonic descriptors (such as roughness, harmonicity, concordance and harmonic change) for each hand-segmented chord of one or more audio excerpts, and plots any two of them against each other as a map of points or trajectories.

data.note: The only test file was segmentation.txt (132 bytes, chord onset times). No WAV was available. The Onsets slot of Audio 1 and Audio 2 accepted it. As a probe it was also given to the 'Main sound file' and 'Separated audio tracks' slots. The app accepted it in both, but Compute descriptors made no plot and showed no error, because the file is not audio. No descriptor values were ever computed, so the scatter/trajectory map never appeared.

tree.general: Describe and compare the harmonic character of chords and chord transitions in recorded music on a 2D descriptor map
tree.specific: Compute static/dynamic harmonic descriptors on CQT spectra synchronised to a hand-made chord segmentation and plot two descriptors as points or trajectories

features.name: Multi-item input tabs with paired files
features.general: Add one tab per sample. Each tab holds a primary data file, optional sub-component files and a matching annotation file. Loading the primary file reveals a preview and a title box; tabs can be removed again.
features.specific: Add Audio input creates an 'Audio N' tab with Main sound file N, Separated audio tracks (multi-file) and Onsets drop zones. Uploading a main file shows an audio player and a 'Change the title' box (renaming does not change the tab label). Delete Audio input removes the current tab and is hidden when only one tab is left.
steps: upload the main recording (player and title box appear)
optionally upload the separated voice tracks
optionally rename the excerpt in Change the title
press Delete Audio input to drop a tab
serves_tasks: Load the main recording of the excerpt
Attach the chord segmentation (onset times) to the recording
Attach separate per-voice recordings of the same excerpt
Give the excerpt a readable name
Add more excerpts to compare on the same map

features.name: Spectral analysis settings panel with conditional percussive filter
features.general: A collapsible panel to set the frequency band, the window function and an optional noise-separation filter. Turning the filter on reveals its strength slider.
features.specific: Advanced settings: Minimal/Maximal pitch selectors (C0 to B9 note names) for the CQT range, Window shape (Hann/Hamming/Blackman/Flattop/Boxcar/Triang), and a 'Reduction of percussive part' switch that reveals an HPSS Margin slider (1 to 20). Each setting has a 'More details' link to the librosa or scipy docs. The pitch boxes are too narrow to show the chosen value.
steps: switch on Reduction of percussive part
serves_tasks: Limit the frequency range and choose the analysis window
Filter out percussive content before analysis

features.name: Measure-family selector linked to the axis pickers
features.general: Choose which family of measures to compute. The x/y axis menus then offer only the measures in that family. Measures that need extra inputs stay greyed out until every sample has them, and choosing 'all' adds a family switch for the plot.
features.specific: The Static / Dynamic / All descriptors radio sets what Compute descriptors calculates and what the X/Y dropdowns list. Static lists Roughness, Harmonicity and Harmonicity inverse, with Concordance and Concordance Totale greyed out until every Audio tab has Separated audio tracks. Dynamic lists Harmonic Change, Differential Concordance and Differential Roughness (list contents read from the page structure). All adds a 'Type of descriptors' Static/Dynamic switch. Changing the descriptor family resets the axis choices. Compute produced no output in this run.
steps: pick Static, Dynamic or All descriptors
if All, choose Static or Dynamic under Type of descriptors
serves_tasks: Choose whether to measure single chords, chord-to-chord transitions, or both
Choose which two measures go on the x and y axes

features.name: Descriptor map display and axis-range options
features.general: Switches for drawing a 2D map: connect points in order and normalise values. With normalisation on, each sample can get its own axis scale; with it off, the axis ranges are typed in by hand.
features.specific: Visualise trajectories and Normalize values switches. 'Rescale axes for every audio' is shown only while Normalize values is on; with it off, x/y range boxes and an Update axis button appear instead. An Advanced options section shows one tab per Audio input; its panels stayed empty because nothing was computed.
steps: with Normalize on, toggle Rescale axes for every audio
with Normalize off, type x/y ranges and press Update axis
serves_tasks: Set how the map is drawn and scaled
